parsed_json.up: Select approved drugs with mechanism action_type 'BLOCKER'. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism on molregno, then to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN to enforce structure availability. Filter molecule_dictionary.max_phase = 4 and drug_mechanism.action_type = 'BLOCKER'. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id (from target_dictionary.chembl_id), and target_name (from target_dictionary.pref_name). Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name.
